source(output(
		ProcessedDate as timestamp,
		recCnt_Before as string,
		Filename as string,
		recCnt_After as integer,
		reconDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> tblIntellimatchGLMonthlyHistorical
tblIntellimatchGLMonthlyHistorical sink(input(
		ProcessedDate as string,
		recCnt_before as string,
		Filename as string,
		recCnt_After as string,
		ReconDate as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ProcessedDate,
		recCnt_before = recCnt_Before,
		Filename,
		recCnt_After,
		ReconDate = reconDate)) ~> LastThirtyDaysIntellimatch
